Structural Heart.title: Long-Term Survival Advantage of Reoperative Surgical Mitral Valve Replacement Over Transcatheter Mitral Valve-in-Valve: A Multicenter Cohort.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、失敗した生体弁の僧帽弁に対する経カテーテル僧帽弁インバルブ置換（mViV）と再手術による僧帽弁置換（rSMVR）の長期的な結果を比較しています。結果は、mViVが短期的な結果は同等である一方、rSMVRが長期的な生存率と血行動態の持続性において優れていることを示しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study compares long-term outcomes between transcatheter mitral valve-in-valve replacement (mViV) and reoperative surgical mitral valve replacement (rSMVR) in patients with failing mitral bioprostheses. The results indicate that while mViV has comparable short-term outcomes, rSMVR offers significantly better long-term survival and hemodynamic durability.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 229 (90 rSMVR, 139 mViV)
Mean age: 66.0 vs 68.7 years
30-day mortality: 20.3% vs 40.9%; P = .01
Mean mitral gradients (immediate postprocedure): 5.1 [2.3] mm Hg vs 7.8 [3.0] mm Hg; P < .001
Mean mitral gradients (5-year): 5.3 [2.0] mm Hg vs 9.8 [5.3] mm Hg; P < .001
Freedom from mitral valve reintervention: 5.8% vs 6.1%; P = .97
Cumulative heart failure incidence: 14.3% vs 22.9%; P = .17
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: rSMVRはmViVに比べて長期的な生存率が優れています。
Structural Heart.authors: Won D, Bolling SF, Romano MA, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Effects of under- and overexpansion on performance of Edwards SAPIEN 3 and MyVal OCTACOR transcatheter heart valves.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究では、シミュレーターを使用してエドワーズSAPIEN 3およびMyVal OCTACOR経カテーテル心臓弁の性能をさまざまな拡張条件下で評価しました。両方の弁は正常サイズに成功裏に膨張され、SAPIEN 3は13％の過膨張に耐え機能し続けましたが、OCTACORは20.9％の過膨張で失敗し、バルブインバルブの置換が必要でした。これらの結果は、小児用弁置換の潜在的な応用を示唆していますが、拡張の慎重な考慮が必要です。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study evaluated the performance of Edwards SAPIEN 3 and MyVal OCTACOR transcatheter heart valves under varying expansion conditions using a simulator. Both valves were successfully inflated to nominal sizes, with SAPIEN 3 tolerating a 13% overexpansion and remaining functional, while OCTACOR experienced failure at a 20.9% overexpansion, necessitating valve-in-valve replacement. These findings suggest potential applications for pediatric valve replacements, although careful consideration of expansion is advised.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
SAPIEN 3 overexpansion: 13% (3 mm)
OCTACOR overexpansion: 20.9% (4.5 mm)
Inflation pressure for SAPIEN 3 at 26 mm: 5.5 atm
Inflation pressure for OCTACOR at 26 mm: 7 atm
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: SAPIEN 3は過膨張に耐え、OCTACORは失敗する可能性がある。
Structural Heart.authors: Haddad Raymond N, Albenque Grégoire, Batteux Clément, et al.

Structural Heart.title: IPEC2 study sheds light on experiences of women with cardiovascular disease
Structural Heart.summary_jp: IPEC2研究は心血管疾患を持つ女性の経験を強調し、医療の助けを求める遅れや診断のギャップを明らかにしています。8カ国で実施されたこの研究は、性別バイアスの影響と、心疾患に苦しむ女性に対する迅速な診断と治療の必要性を強調しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: The IPEC2 study highlights the experiences of women with cardiovascular disease, revealing delays in seeking medical help and gaps in diagnosis. Conducted across eight countries, the research emphasizes the impact of gender bias and the need for timely diagnosis and treatment for women suffering from heart disease.
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: 女性は心疾患の診断と治療において遅れが生じている。

Structural Heart.title: Temporal trends in mitral edge-to-edge repair for primary mitral regurgitation.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、一次僧帽弁逆流症（PMR）に対する経皮的エッジ・ツー・エッジ修復（M-TEER）の安全性、効果、および安定性の時間的傾向を分析しています。3,082人の患者からのPRIME-MRレジストリのデータは、時間とともに症状の重症度、合併症率、技術的有効性が大幅に改善されたことを示しています。結果は、M-TEERがPMR患者にとってより効果的で安全になったことを示しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: The study analyzes temporal trends in the safety, efficacy, and stability of mitral valve transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (M-TEER) for primary mitral regurgitation (PMR). Data from the PRIME-MR registry involving 3,082 patients show significant improvements in symptomatic severity, complication rates, and technical efficacy over time. The findings indicate that M-TEER has become more effective and safer for PMR patients.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 3082 (patients)
Median age: 82 years (interquartile range 76.0-85.0)
Female: 45.1%
NYHA Class ≥III: 80.4%
NYHA Class ≥III (2009-2013): 85.9%
NYHA Class ≥III (2020-2023): 71.8%
STS score (2009-2013): 5.6%
STS score (2020-2023): 4.6%; p for trend<0.0001
Complications (2009-2013): 42.4%
Complications (2020-2023): 23.1%; p for trend<0.0001
Residual MR ≤1+ (2009-2013): 54.0%
Residual MR ≤1+ (2020-2023): 68.4%; p for trend<0.001
Stable results at 1-year follow-up (2009-2013): 63.6%
Stable results at 1-year follow-up (2020-2023): 74.4%; p for trend=0.03
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: M-TEERによるPMR治療は時間とともに安全性と効果が向上しています。
Structural Heart.authors: Koell B, Ludwig S, Weimann J, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Transcatheter edge-to-edge repair for primary mitral regurgitation: what lies ahead?
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この記事では、一次的僧帽弁逆流症の治療における経カテーテルのエッジ・ツー・エッジ修復技術の将来の展望について論じています。分野の進展と患者の転帰への潜在的な影響が強調されています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: The article discusses the future prospects of transcatheter edge-to-edge repair techniques for treating primary mitral regurgitation. It highlights the advancements in the field and potential implications for patient outcomes.
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: 経カテーテルのエッジ・ツー・エッジ修復技術の将来に期待が寄せられています。

Structural Heart.title: Outcomes of intraprocedural haemodynamic changes in patients undergoing mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、ミトラル経カテーテルエッジ・ツー・エッジ修復（M-TEER）中の平均左心房圧（mLAP）低下の予後的意義をOCEAN-Mitralレジストリのデータを用いて評価しています。結果は、mLAPの低下が変性型僧帽弁逆流（DMR）患者の臨床結果の改善に関連している一方、機能的僧帽弁逆流（FMR）患者にはそのような関連が見られないことを示しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study evaluates the prognostic significance of intraprocedural mean left atrial pressure (mLAP) reduction during mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (M-TEER) using data from the OCEAN-Mitral registry. The findings indicate that mLAP reduction is associated with improved clinical outcomes in patients with degenerative mitral regurgitation (DMR), while no such association is observed in those with functional mitral regurgitation (FMR).
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 2629 (total patients)
Postprocedural mLAP decrease: 1548 (58.9%)
Adjusted HR (DMR): 0.66 (95% CI: 0.45-0.96; p=0.028)
Adjusted HR (FMR): 0.90 (95% CI: 0.75-1.08; p=0.251)
Interaction p-value: 0.006
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: M-TEER中のmLAP低下は、変性型僧帽弁逆流患者の臨床結果改善に関連しています。
Structural Heart.authors: Kuwata S, Izumo M, Tanaka T, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Transcatheter Mitral Edge-to-Edge Repair With Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump Support in Severe Left Ventricular Dysfunction.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この記事では、重度の機能的僧帽弁逆流症を持つ左心室機能不全の患者に対する経カテーテルエッジ・ツー・エッジ修復（TEER）の使用と、経大動脈バルーンポンプ（IABP）による支援について説明しています。5人の患者全員が手技の成功を収め、手術後の機能状態が改善したことから、IABPが標準治療の対象外の高リスク患者における安全なTEERを可能にする可能性が示唆されています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This article discusses the use of transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) for severe functional mitral regurgitation in patients with advanced left ventricular dysfunction, supported by an intra-aortic balloon pump (IABP). All five patients achieved procedural success and improved functional status post-procedure, suggesting that IABP may enable safe TEER in high-risk patients who are otherwise ineligible for standard treatments.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 5 (patients)
LV ejection fraction: 9%-29% (range)
NYHA functional class: I-II (at discharge)
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: IABPは重度の機能的僧帽弁逆流症患者におけるTEERを安全に可能にするかもしれない。
Structural Heart.authors: Wedinly S, Al-Bawardy R, Kashkari W, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve Replacement: When do Signals Become Evidence?
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この記事では、経カテーテル三尖弁置換術（TTVR）に関する新たな証拠と信号について論じています。TTVRの文脈において、予備的な信号と確固たる証拠を区別する重要性が強調されています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: The article discusses the emerging evidence and signals regarding transcatheter tricuspid valve replacement (TTVR) procedures. It highlights the importance of distinguishing between preliminary signals and robust evidence in the context of TTVR.
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: TTVRの信号と証拠の区別が重要です。

Structural Heart.title: Cardiovascular magnetic resonance reclassification of aortic regurgitation after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: A COMPARE-TAVI 1 substudy.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）後の大動脈逆流（AR）評価における心血管磁気共鳴（CMR）と経胸壁超音波検査（TTE）の有効性を評価しています。結果は、TTEがARの重症度を過大評価する可能性があることを示しており、CMRは中等度以上のARの発生率が低いことを明らかにしました。この結果は、TAVI後のARのより正確な評価にCMRの重要性を強調しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) compared to transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) in assessing aortic regurgitation (AR) after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). The results indicate that TTE may overestimate AR severity, as CMR identified lower rates of moderate or greater AR. The findings highlight the importance of using CMR for more accurate assessment of AR post-TAVI.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 327 (participants)
AR none-trace-mild: 88.4% (n = 289)
AR mild-moderate: 10.1% (n = 33)
AR moderate: 0.9% (n = 3)
AR moderate-severe: 0.6% (n = 2)
AR fraction (CMR): 5% [3-9]
Overall agreement: 86%
Sensitivity: 0.00 (95% CI 0.00-0.98)
Specificity: 0.99 (95% CI 0.97-1.00)
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: CMRはTTEに比べて大動脈逆流の重症度評価において補完的な価値を持つ。
Structural Heart.authors: Pedersen AAU, Pedersen ALD, Mogensen NSB, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Leaflet Perforation as a Complication of Tricuspid Transcatheter Edge-to-Edge Repair.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: 虚血性心筋症、心房細動、および重度の TR を患っていることが知られている 68 歳の男性は、腹水排出を必要とする右心不全を呈しました。心臓チームの議論の後、彼は選択的 TEER の入院を認められた。
Structural Heart.summary_en: A 68-year-old man known to have ischemic cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation, and severe TR presented with right heart failure requiring ascitic drainage. After heart team discussion, he was admitted for elective TEER.
Structural Heart.outcomes: During deployment of a second clip, transesophageal echocardiography revealed an iatrogenic perforation of the posterior leaflet. The clip was withdrawn, however attempts to plug the perforation were unsuccessful, resulting in severe residual TR.
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: A 68-year-old man known to have ischemic cardiomyopathy, atrial fibrillation, and severe TR presented with right heart failure requiring ascitic drainage. After heart team discussion, he was admitted for elective TEER.
Structural Heart.authors: Almarshud N, Shah MA, Alqahtani F, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Response in renal function after transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、慢性腎疾患（CKD）および重度の三尖弁逆流症（TR）を持つ患者における経カテーテル三尖弁エッジ・トゥ・エッジ修復（T-TEER）の腎機能への影響を調査しています。結果は、手術後に腎機能が有意に改善し、すべてのCKDステージで急性腎障害（AKI）の発生率が大幅に減少したことを示しています。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study investigates the effects of transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) on renal function in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and severe tricuspid regurgitation. Results show significant improvement in renal function post-procedure, with a marked decrease in acute kidney injury (AKI) incidence across all CKD stages.
Structural Heart.outcomes:
Sample size: 181
Follow-up: median 125 days (IQR 6-506; up to 1280 days)
eGFR improvement: +4.8 mL/min/1.73 m2 (IQR 3.1;6.5; p<0.001)
AKI incidence reduction: rate ratios 0.18-0.39 (60-80% reduction)
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: T-TEERは腎機能を改善し、AKIのリスクを低下させる可能性があります。
Structural Heart.authors: Becker M, Kraft L, Oberacker T, et al.

Structural Heart.title: Comparative Analysis of Leaflet Materials, Stent Materials, and Stent Cell Density for Bileaflet Transcatheter Mitral Valve Design.
Structural Heart.summary_jp: この研究は、異なるリーフレット材料とステント設計を分析することで、バイリーフレット経カテーテル僧帽弁（TMV）の生体力学的性能を調査しています。結果は、リーフレット材料が弁の性能に大きく影響し、ステント材料とセル密度は二次的な効果を持つことを示しています。これらの知見は、改良されたTMVデバイスの設計に役立つ可能性があります。
Structural Heart.summary_en: This study investigates the biomechanical performance of bileaflet transcatheter mitral valves (TMVs) by analyzing different leaflet materials and stent designs. The results indicate that leaflet material significantly influences valve performance, while stent material and cell density have secondary effects. These insights could inform the design of improved TMV devices.
Structural Heart.outcomes: UPP achieved the largest opening (30-32%) with the lowest leaflet 99th percentile stresses (0.048-0.050 MPa), while FBP1 produced the smallest opening (8-9%) and highest leaflet stresses (0.077-0.078 MPa). Leaflet 99th percentile stress was strongly inversely correlated with valve opening (Spearman r=-0.9, p<0.01). Stent material had a negligible effect on valve opening but affected stent stress notably, with nitinol exhibiting about 2-3 orders of magnitude lower stresses compared to CoCr.
Structural Heart.key_takeaway: リーフレット材料がバイリーフレットTMVの生体力学的性能に最も大きな影響を与える。
Structural Heart.authors: Nwokeafor JC, Hofmeister JD, Yeats BB, et al.

General MedTech.title: Rethinking FDA audit readiness: A faster path to sustainable compliance
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事では、MedTech組織にとっての継続的な監査準備の重要性について論じており、これにより効率的に運営しながら、コンプライアンスに対する信頼とコントロールを維持できると強調しています。監査に対する積極的なアプローチが持続可能なコンプライアンスへの迅速な道を開くことを示唆しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The article discusses the importance of continuous audit readiness for MedTech organizations, emphasizing that it allows them to operate more efficiently while maintaining confidence and control over compliance. It suggests that a proactive approach to audits can lead to faster paths to sustainable compliance.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 継続的な監査準備が効率的な運営を可能にする。

General MedTech.title: In a first, Dexcom’s OTC glucose sensor is cleared for kids
General MedTech.summary_jp: DexcomのOTCグルコースモニター「Stelo」が、2歳から使用できるように承認されました。これは、若年患者のためにグルコースモニタリングをより利用しやすくする重要なステップです。
General MedTech.summary_en: Dexcom's Stelo over-the-counter glucose monitor has received clearance for use in children as young as two years old. This marks a significant step in making glucose monitoring more accessible for younger patients.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: Dexcomのグルコースモニターが2歳から使用可能に。

General MedTech.title: Anesthesia Machine Correction: Draeger, Inc. Issues Correction for Atlan A350 and A350XL Anesthesia Workstations
General MedTech.summary_jp: ドレーガー社は、使用中に換気装置が故障する可能性のある製造エラーのため、Atlan A350およびA350XL麻酔作業ステーションの修正を発表しました。この措置は、患者の安全とデバイスの信頼性を確保することを目的としています。
General MedTech.summary_en: Draeger, Inc. has issued a correction for its Atlan A350 and A350XL anesthesia workstations due to a manufacturing error that could lead to ventilator failure during use. This action aims to ensure patient safety and device reliability.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: ドレーガー社が麻酔作業ステーションの修正を発表。

General MedTech.title: Top medtech stories from ADA’s Scientific Sessions
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事では、アメリカ糖尿病協会の年次イベントからのハイライトを取り上げ、Dexcom、Abbott、MiniMed、Insuletなどの企業の新しい技術を紹介しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The article covers highlights from the American Diabetes Association's annual event, showcasing upcoming technologies from companies like Dexcom, Abbott, MiniMed, and Insulet.
General MedTech.outcomes: The article covers highlights from the American Diabetes Association's annual event, showcasing upcoming technologies from companies like Dexcom, Abbott, MiniMed, and Insulet.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: アメリカ糖尿病協会の年次イベントで新技術が紹介されました。

General MedTech.title: Beekeeper’s Naturals Issues Voluntary Nationwide Recall of Beekeeper’s Naturals Saline Nasal Spray Sold Through Amazon Due to Microbial Contamination
General MedTech.summary_jp: Beekeeper’s Naturalsは、微生物汚染のために特定のロットの生理食塩水スプレーを全国的に自主回収することを発表しました。この製品はAmazonでのみ販売されており、消費者の安全を確保するために回収されています。
General MedTech.summary_en: Beekeeper’s Naturals has issued a voluntary nationwide recall of a specific lot of their Saline Nasal Spray due to microbial contamination. The affected product was sold exclusively through Amazon and is being recalled to ensure consumer safety.
General MedTech.outcomes: Beekeeper’s Naturals has issued a voluntary nationwide recall of a specific lot of their Saline Nasal Spray due to microbial contamination. The affected product was sold exclusively through Amazon and is being recalled to ensure consumer safety.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 微生物汚染のため、生理食塩水スプレーが自主回収されました。

General MedTech.title: Convenience Kit Correction: Medline Issues Correction for Kits Containing Huons Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in Dextrose Injection, USP
General MedTech.summary_jp: メドラインは、Huons Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in Dextrose Injection, USPを含む便利キットの修正を行い、リコールされた成分を取り除いています。
General MedTech.summary_en: Medline is issuing a correction for convenience kits that contain Huons Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in Dextrose Injection, USP, by removing the recalled components.
General MedTech.outcomes: Medline is issuing a correction for convenience kits that contain Huons Bupivacaine Hydrochloride in Dextrose Injection, USP, by removing the recalled components.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: メドラインがリコール成分を取り除く修正を行っています。

General MedTech.title: Why Insulet thinks its fully closed loop system will stand apart from rivals
General MedTech.summary_jp: Insuletの最高医療責任者であるトラン・リー氏は、2型糖尿病管理のための完全閉ループシステムについて語り、MiniMedやTandem Diabetes Careの競合製品とは異なる点を強調しました。
General MedTech.summary_en: Insulet's Chief Medical Officer, Trang Ly, discusses the company's fully closed loop system for managing Type 2 diabetes, emphasizing its distinctiveness compared to competitors like MiniMed and Tandem Diabetes Care.
General MedTech.outcomes: Insulet's Chief Medical Officer, Trang Ly, discusses the company's fully closed loop system for managing Type 2 diabetes, emphasizing its distinctiveness compared to competitors like MiniMed and Tandem Diabetes Care.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: Insuletの新しいシステムは競合と異なると強調されています。

General MedTech.title: Early Alert: Positive Pressure Breathing Device Issue from Baxter
General MedTech.summary_jp: バクスターは、ボララシステムの患者回路に関する潜在的な問題について警告を発しました。この問題は、治療中に空気や薬剤が漏れる可能性があり、患者の酸素供給が減少し、ネブライゼーションが効果的でなくなる可能性があります。
General MedTech.summary_en: Baxter has issued an alert regarding a potential issue with the Volara system patient circuits, which may leak air and medication during therapy. This could result in reduced oxygenation and ineffective nebulization for patients.
General MedTech.outcomes: Baxter has issued an alert regarding a potential issue with the Volara system patient circuits, which may leak air and medication during therapy.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: ボララシステムの患者回路に空気や薬剤の漏れの可能性があります。

General MedTech.title: Heart Pump Correction: Abiomed Issues Correction for Automated Impella Controllers
General MedTech.summary_jp: Abiomedは、自動インペラコントローラーに関する修正を発表しました。これは、血行動態サポートに影響を与える可能性のある安全上の懸念に対処するために必要です。
General MedTech.summary_en: Abiomed has issued a correction for its Automated Impella Controllers due to potential safety concerns that may affect hemodynamic support. The update is necessary to ensure the reliability of the heart pump system.
General MedTech.outcomes: Abiomed has issued a correction for its Automated Impella Controllers due to potential safety concerns that may affect hemodynamic support.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: Abiomedが自動インペラコントローラーの修正を発表。

General MedTech.title: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization for Generic Over-the-Counter Drug to Treat New World Screwworm in Dogs and Cats
General MedTech.summary_jp: FDAは、犬と猫の新世界スクリューワーム感染症の治療のために、一般的なニテンプラム錠剤に対して緊急使用許可を発行しました。この薬は、体重が少なくとも2ポンドで、4週間以上の動物に使用が承認されています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The FDA has granted Emergency Use Authorization for generic Nitenpyram Tablets to treat New World screwworm infestations in dogs and cats. This drug is approved for use in animals weighing at least two pounds and at least four weeks old.
General MedTech.outcomes: The FDA has granted Emergency Use Authorization for generic Nitenpyram Tablets to treat New World screwworm infestations in dogs and cats. This drug is approved for use in animals weighing at least two pounds and at least four weeks old.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 犬と猫の新世界スクリューワーム感染症治療のために、ニテンプラム錠剤が緊急使用許可を取得。

General MedTech.title: Navigating cardiovascular imaging fellowships
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事では、心臓画像診断フェローシップの重要性について、スキルを磨き、さまざまな技術や診断への露出を増やすことが強調されています。また、2022年の心臓病学カリキュラムがサブスペシャリティトレーニングに与える影響と、追加のフェローシップの必要性が予想されることについても言及されています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The article discusses the importance of cardiac imaging fellowships in refining skills and increasing exposure to various techniques and diagnoses. It highlights the potential impact of the 2022 cardiology curriculum on subspecialty training and the anticipated need for additional fellowships.
General MedTech.outcomes: The article discusses the importance of cardiac imaging fellowships in refining skills and increasing exposure to various techniques and diagnoses. It highlights the potential impact of the 2022 cardiology curriculum on subspecialty training and the anticipated need for additional fellowships.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 心臓画像診断フェローシップの需要が高まる可能性があります。

General MedTech.title: Non-atherosclerotic myocardial infarction in hypereosinophilic syndrome: emerging insights and therapeutic approaches
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事では、好酸球増加症候群（HES）と非動脈硬化性心筋梗塞（MI）の関係をレビューし、HES関連のMIの独自のメカニズムと管理戦略を強調しています。HESに関連する心血管疾患の診断におけるパラダイムシフトの必要性を強調し、今後の研究の方向性を提案しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: This article reviews the relationship between hypereosinophilic syndrome (HES) and non-atherosclerotic myocardial infarction (MI), highlighting the distinct mechanisms and management strategies for HES-related MI. It emphasizes the need for a paradigm shift in diagnosing cardiovascular diseases associated with HES and suggests future research directions.
General MedTech.outcomes: This article reviews the relationship between hypereosinophilic syndrome (HES) and non-atherosclerotic myocardial infarction (MI), highlighting the distinct mechanisms and management strategies for HES-related MI. It emphasizes the need for a paradigm shift in diagnosing cardiovascular diseases associated with HES and suggests future research directions.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 好酸球増加症候群は非動脈硬化性心筋梗塞を引き起こす。

General MedTech.title: Effect of ketone supplementation, a low-carbohydrate diet and a ketogenic diet on heart failure measures and outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
General MedTech.summary_jp: この系統的レビューとメタアナリシスは、ケトン補給、低炭水化物ダイエット、ケトジェニックダイエットが心不全の結果に与える影響を評価しました。結果は、ケトン補給が特に左室駆出率や心不全のある患者において心機能を有意に改善することを示しています。低炭水化物およびケトジェニックダイエットが心不全の結果に与える影響を理解するためには、さらなる研究が必要です。
General MedTech.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effects of ketone supplementation, low-carbohydrate diets, and ketogenic diets on heart failure outcomes. The findings indicate that ketone supplementation significantly improved left ventricular ejection fraction and other cardiac measures, particularly in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). Further research is necessary to understand the impact of low-carbohydrate and ketogenic diets on heart failure outcomes.
General MedTech.outcomes:
Left ventricular ejection fraction: 3.12% (95% CI 0.95% to 5.30%, p<0.01)
Left ventricular ejection fraction in HFrEF: 4.25% (95% CI 1.99% to 6.51%, p<0.001)
Peak systolic annular velocity in HFrEF: 0.60% (95% CI 0.17% to 1.02%, p<0.01)
Cardiac output in HFrEF: 1.24 L/min (95% CI 0.24 to 2.24, p<0.05)
General MedTech.key_takeaway: ケトン補給は心不全のある患者の心機能を改善することが示されています。

General MedTech.title: Little learning is a dangerous thing: the hollowing of medical apprenticeship in cardiology
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事は、心臓病学における医療の見習いの重要性と、医療提供者の不十分な訓練や知識に伴うリスクについて論じています。患者の安全を確保するために、適切な監督と医療専門家の道徳的責任の必要性を強調しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The article discusses the importance of medical apprenticeship in cardiology and the risks associated with insufficient training and knowledge among healthcare providers. It emphasizes the need for proper supervision and the moral responsibilities of medical professionals to ensure patient safety.
General MedTech.outcomes: The article discusses the importance of medical apprenticeship in cardiology and the risks associated with insufficient training and knowledge among healthcare providers. It emphasizes the need for proper supervision and the moral responsibilities of medical professionals to ensure patient safety.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: 医療の見習いの重要性と患者安全の確保が強調されています。

General MedTech.title: Correction: Impact of cascade screening for catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia type 1
General MedTech.summary_jp: この記事は、カテコールアミン多形性心室頻拍タイプ1に関する以前に発表された研究の訂正です。アミノ酸範囲の誤りを明確にし、変異の位置に関する修正情報を提供しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: This article is a correction regarding the previously published study on cascade screening for catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia type 1. It clarifies an error in the amino acid range and provides corrected information about the location of variants.
General MedTech.outcomes: This article is a correction regarding the previously published study on cascade screening for catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia type 1.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: カテコールアミン多形性心室頻拍に関する研究の訂正が行われた。

General MedTech.title: Bausch + Lomb to lay off employees in Missouri
General MedTech.summary_jp: ボシュロムは、製造拠点からの生産移転の一環として、12月中旬までにミズーリ州で119人の従業員を解雇する計画です。
General MedTech.summary_en: Bausch + Lomb is planning to lay off 119 employees in Missouri by mid-December as part of a phased transfer of production from the manufacturing site.
General MedTech.outcomes: ボシュロムは、製造拠点からの生産移転の一環として、12月中旬までにミズーリ州で119人の従業員を解雇する計画です。
General MedTech.key_takeaway: ボシュロムがミズーリ州で119人を解雇する計画。

General MedTech.title: GT Medical raises $100M for brain tumor tech after clinical trial success
General MedTech.summary_jp: GT Medicalは、臨床試験の成功を受けて脳腫瘍技術の開発のために1億ドルを調達しました。同社は、GammaTile放射線治療インプラントの採用が増加しており、これを標準治療として確立することを目指しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: GT Medical has successfully raised $100 million to further develop its brain tumor technology following positive results from clinical trials. The company reports growing adoption of its GammaTile radiotherapy implant, which it aims to establish as a standard treatment.
General MedTech.outcomes: GT Medical has successfully raised $100 million to further develop its brain tumor technology following positive results from clinical trials. The company reports growing adoption of its GammaTile radiotherapy implant, which it aims to establish as a standard treatment.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: GT Medicalが脳腫瘍技術のために1億ドルを調達。

General MedTech.title: Medtronic gets FDA nod for updated pulse oximetry system
General MedTech.summary_jp: メドトロニックは、さまざまな患者集団や臨床環境での精度を向上させるために更新されたパルスオキシメトリーシステムのFDA承認を受けました。この進展は、肌の色に関係なく信頼できる測定値を確保することで、患者ケアの向上を目指しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: Medtronic has received FDA approval for an updated pulse oximetry system designed to improve accuracy across various patient populations and clinical settings. This advancement aims to enhance patient care by ensuring reliable readings regardless of skin tone.
General MedTech.outcomes: Medtronic has received FDA approval for an updated pulse oximetry system designed to improve accuracy across various patient populations and clinical settings.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: メドトロニックが更新されたパルスオキシメトリーシステムのFDA承認を取得。

General MedTech.title: Medtronic set for Stealth AXiS expansion in Europe
General MedTech.summary_jp: メドトロニックは、耳、鼻、喉の手術に対するCEマークを取得したことで、Stealth AXiSという高度な手術ナビゲーションプラットフォームの欧州での展開を拡大します。この拡大により、地域のより多くの外科医が手術能力を向上させることを目指しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: Medtronic is expanding the availability of its advanced surgical navigation platform, Stealth AXiS, in Europe following the receipt of the CE mark for ear, nose, and throat procedures. This expansion aims to enhance surgical capabilities for more surgeons in the region.
General MedTech.outcomes: Medtronic is expanding the availability of its advanced surgical navigation platform, Stealth AXiS, in Europe following the receipt of the CE mark for ear, nose, and throat procedures. This expansion aims to enhance surgical capabilities for more surgeons in the region.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: メドトロニックがStealth AXiSの欧州展開を拡大。

General MedTech.title: FDA Expands Sunscreen Options for the First Time in 20 Years
General MedTech.summary_jp: FDAは20年ぶりに新しい日焼け止め成分としてベモトリジノールを承認し、日焼け止め製品の革新を促進しています。
General MedTech.summary_en: The FDA has added bemotrizinol to the list of approved sunscreen active ingredients for the first time in 20 years, promoting innovation in sunscreen products.
General MedTech.outcomes: The FDA has added bemotrizinol to the list of approved sunscreen active ingredients for the first time in 20 years, promoting innovation in sunscreen products.
General MedTech.key_takeaway: FDAが20年ぶりに新しい日焼け止め成分を承認しました。

M&A / Business.title: Medtronic closes Scientia Vascular takeover, continuing M&A streak
M&A / Business.summary_jp: メドトロニックは、医療機器分野での合併・買収のトレンドを継続し、Scientia Vascularの買収を完了しました。CEOのジェフ・マーサは、この買収によりメドトロニックが神経血管手技のリーダーとなると述べました。
M&A / Business.summary_en: Medtronic has completed its acquisition of Scientia Vascular, continuing its trend of mergers and acquisitions in the medical device sector. CEO Geoff Martha stated that this acquisition will position Medtronic as a leader in neurovascular procedures.
M&A / Business.key_takeaway: メドトロニックがScientia Vascularを買収し、神経血管手技のリーダーを目指す。

M&A / Business.title: J&J recalls Impella controllers over hardware issues
M&A / Business.summary_jp: ジョンソン・エンド・ジョンソンのアビオメッドは、ハードウェアの問題によりインペラコントローラーをリコールしました。これは、最近数年でのこれらのデバイスに関する別のリコールを示しています。
M&A / Business.summary_en: Johnson & Johnson's Abiomed has issued a recall for Impella controllers due to hardware issues, marking another recall in recent years for these devices. This action highlights ongoing concerns regarding the safety and reliability of Impella products.
M&A / Business.outcomes: Johnson & Johnson's Abiomed has issued a recall for Impella controllers due to hardware issues, marking another recall in recent years for these devices.
M&A / Business.key_takeaway: インペラコントローラーのハードウェア問題でリコール。

M&A / Business.title: Penumbra’s FDA nod for clot removal tech a win for Boston Scientific
M&A / Business.summary_jp: ペナンブラが血栓除去技術に対するFDAの承認を受け、ボストン・サイエンティフィックに約1億ドルの追加収益をもたらすと予測されています。この開発は、ボストン・サイエンティフィックの脳卒中治療市場における戦略的な動きを浮き彫りにしています。
M&A / Business.summary_en: Penumbra has received FDA approval for its clot removal technology, which is expected to generate approximately $100 million in additional revenue for Boston Scientific, the acquiring company. This development highlights the strategic move by Boston Scientific in the stroke treatment market.
M&A / Business.outcomes: Penumbra has received FDA approval for its clot removal technology, which is expected to generate approximately $100 million in additional revenue for Boston Scientific, the acquiring company. This development highlights the strategic move by Boston Scientific in the stroke treatment market.
M&A / Business.key_takeaway: ペナンブラのFDA承認はボストン・サイエンティフィックにとって重要な収益源となる。

M&A / Business.title: Danaher closes $9.9B Masimo buyout
M&A / Business.summary_jp: ダナハーはマシモの買収を99億ドルで完了しました。CEOのレイナー・ブレアは、同社がさまざまな事業分野でさらなる取引を追求する準備が整っていると述べました。
M&A / Business.summary_en: Danaher has successfully completed its acquisition of Masimo for $9.9 billion. CEO Rainer Blair indicated that the company is well-positioned to pursue additional deals across its various business sectors.
M&A / Business.outcomes: Danaher has successfully completed its acquisition of Masimo for $9.9 billion.
M&A / Business.key_takeaway: ダナハーがマシモを99億ドルで買収しました。

Interventional Cardiology.title: First patients enrolled in study of pulsatile IVL in coronary artery disease
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: Amplitude Vascular Systemsは、冠動脈疾患の治療を目的とした脈動血管内体外衝撃波治療（PIVL）の初のヒト試験において、最初の患者を登録しました。POWER CAD I研究では、中等度から重度の石灰化冠動脈を有する患者に対するPulse IVLシステムの実現可能性を評価し、オーストラリアとニュージーランドで合計15名の被験者を登録する予定です。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: Amplitude Vascular Systems has enrolled the first patient in its first-in-human study for pulsatile intravascular lithotripsy (PIVL) therapy aimed at treating coronary artery disease. The POWER CAD I study will assess the feasibility of the Pulse IVL system in patients with moderate to severely calcified coronary arteries, with a total of 15 subjects expected to be enrolled across Australia and New Zealand.
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: 冠動脈疾患に対する新しい治療法の可能性を探る重要な試験が開始されました。

Interventional Cardiology.title: Four-year data show “favourable” safety and performance of resorbable magnesium scaffold
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: Teleflexは、Freesolve生分解性マグネシウムスキャフォールドを評価したBIOMAG-I臨床試験の4年フォローアップデータを報告しました。この116人の患者を対象とした研究では、2年から4年の間に新たな心臓関連イベントは観察されず、標的病変失敗率は3.5%であり、スキャフォールドの長期的な安全性と性能を支持しています。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: Teleflex has reported four-year follow-up data from the BIOMAG-I clinical study, which evaluated the Freesolve resorbable magnesium scaffold. The study, involving 116 patients, showed no new cardiac-related events between two and four years, with a target lesion failure rate of 3.5%, supporting the scaffold's long-term safety and performance.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes:
Sample size: 116 (patients)
Follow-up: 4 years
Target lesion failure rate: 3.5% (clinically-driven-target lesion revascularisation)
Cardiac death: 0
Target-vessel myocardial infarction: 0
Scaffold thrombosis: 0
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: Freesolveスキャフォールドは、4年間のフォローアップで心臓関連イベントがなく、長期的な安全性と有効性が確認されました。

Interventional Cardiology.title: Predictive value of ultrasound-measured tongue base thickness for upper airway obstruction during monitored anesthesia care: a single-center prospective observational study.
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術を受ける患者におけるモニタリング下麻酔管理（MAC）中の上気道閉塞を予測するための超音波で測定された舌根部の厚さの予測値を評価しました。結果は、上気道閉塞が50％の患者に発生したものの、舌根部の厚さの診断性能は限られており、感度は76.2％、特異度は42.9％でした。舌の厚さとSTOP-BANGスコアを組み合わせても予測精度は向上しませんでした。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: This study evaluated the predictive value of preoperative tongue base thickness measured by ultrasound for upper airway obstruction during monitored anesthesia care (MAC) in patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation. The results indicated that while upper airway obstruction occurred in 50% of the patients, the diagnostic performance of tongue base thickness was limited, with a sensitivity of 76.2% and specificity of 42.9%. Combining tongue thickness with the STOP-BANG score did not enhance predictive accuracy.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes:
Sample size: 42 (patients)
Upper airway obstruction: 21 (50.0%)
Median TT (non-obstruction group): 59.8 mm
Median TT (obstruction group): 61.0 mm (p = 0.466)
TT cut-off value: 58 mm (AUC = 0.566)
Sensitivity: 76.2%
Specificity: 42.9%
PPV: 57.1%
NPV: 64.3%
LR+: 1.33
LR-: 0.56
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: 舌根部の厚さの測定は、上気道閉塞の予測に限られた診断性能を示しました。
Interventional Cardiology.authors: Kikkawa K, Takeuchi M, Sakaguchi D, et al.

Interventional Cardiology.title: Murray law-based quantitative flow ratio for functional assessment of coronary lesions: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: この系統的レビューとメタアナリシスは、侵襲的なフラクショナルフローリザーブ（FFR）を基準として、機能的に重要な冠動脈病変を特定するためのマレー法に基づく定量的フローレシオ（µQFR）の診断精度を評価しました。7つの研究を含む1,826の病変を分析した結果、感度は80.7％、特異度は94.4％であり、有望な診断性能を示していますが、さらなる検証が必要です。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of the Murray law-based quantitative flow ratio (µQFR) for identifying functionally significant coronary lesions, using invasive fractional flow reserve (FFR) as the reference standard. The analysis included seven studies with 1,826 lesions, showing a pooled sensitivity of 80.7% and specificity of 94.4%, indicating promising diagnostic performance but highlighting the need for further validation.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes:
Sensitivity: 0.807 (95% CI 0.690-0.888)
Specificity: 0.944 (95% CI 0.893-0.971)
Positive likelihood ratio: 14.41
Negative likelihood ratio: 0.20
Diagnostic odds ratio: 70.6
Sensitivity in TAVI patients: 0.77 (95% CI 0.64-0.87)
Sensitivity in calcified lesions: 0.72 (95% CI 0.66-0.78)
Sample size: 1826 lesions
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: µQFRは高い特異度を示すが、感度の変動が大きく、さらなる検証が必要。
Interventional Cardiology.authors: Skalidis I, Bennar W, Garin D, et al.

Interventional Cardiology.title: Transcatheter edge-to-edge tricuspid valve repair combining a late-generation 3-dimensional intracardiac echocardiography system with transesophageal guidance.
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル三尖弁エッジ・ツー・エッジ修復（TEER）における3D心内エコーシステムと経食道エコーの併用による手技結果を評価しています。この組み合わせは、放射線被ばくや手技時間を有意に減少させ、安全性を損なうことなく効果的であることが示されています。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: This study evaluates the procedural outcomes of transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair (TEER) using a 3D intracardiac echocardiography system combined with transesophageal echocardiography. The findings indicate that this combination significantly reduces fluoroscopy time, radiation dose, and procedural time without compromising safety.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes:
Sample size: 45 (total)
Fluoroscopy time (ICE+TEE vs TEE): 16.2 [8.9-26.0] minutes vs 26 [18.2-32.0] minutes; P = .003
Radiation dose (ICE+TEE vs TEE): 782 [390-1040] mGy vs 1413 [960-1705] mGy; P = .002
Dose-area product (ICE+TEE vs TEE): 5855 [2675-9328] cGy·cm2 vs 12120 [8670-15080] cGy·cm2; P = .004
Procedural time (ICE+TEE vs TEE): 55 [37-62] minutes vs 72 [50-80] minutes; P = .03
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: 3D ICEガイダンスを用いることで、TEERの放射線被ばくと手技時間が減少する。
Interventional Cardiology.authors: Alperi A, Pascual I, León V, et al.

Interventional Cardiology.title: Unmasking Brugada: when hypokalaemia reveals the hidden phenotype
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: 20代の男性が急性四肢筋力低下と重度の低カリウム血症で救急外来に来院しました。カリウム補充により正常化したECGの再検査ではSTセグメントの変化が見られ、フレカイニドによる薬理学的検査で初期のECGパターンが再現され、隠れたブルガダ表現型が示されました。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: A young man presented with acute limb weakness and severe hypokalaemia, which was corrected with potassium supplementation. A repeat ECG showed normalization of ST-segment changes, and pharmacological testing with flecainide reproduced the initial ECG pattern, indicating a hidden Brugada phenotype.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes:
Serum potassium: 2.0 mmol/L (initial), 4.2 mmol/L (after supplementation)
ECG changes: ST-segment abnormalities (initial), normalization (after treatment)
Flecainide dosage: 2 mg/kg over 10 min
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: 低カリウム血症が隠れたブルガダ表現型を明らかにしました。

Interventional Cardiology.title: Role of physician assistants and their impact on cardiology specialty training in the United Kingdom
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: この記事は、英国における心臓病学のトレーニングにおける医師助手（PA）の役割を調査し、患者の安全性や研修医への影響に関する懸念を強調しています。多くの研修医がPAと共に働いている一方で、彼らの業務範囲や研修機会への悪影響に関する重大な問題が明らかになっています。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: This article investigates the role of physician assistants (PAs) in cardiology training in the UK, highlighting concerns about patient safety and the impact on resident doctors. The study reveals that while many resident doctors have worked with PAs, there are significant issues regarding their scope of practice and the negative effects on training opportunities for residents.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes: The study reveals that while many resident doctors have worked with PAs, there are significant issues regarding their scope of practice and the negative effects on training opportunities for residents.
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: PAの業務範囲と研修医への影響に関する明確なガイドラインが必要です。

Interventional Cardiology.title: Evidence-based implementation of accelerated diagnostic pathway: time for a change
Interventional Cardiology.summary_jp: この記事では、高感度心筋トロポニン（hs-cTn）アッセイを用いた心筋梗塞診断のための加速診断経路（ADP）の実施について説明しています。従来の検査方法から、心筋梗塞の迅速な確認または除外を可能にするより迅速な戦略への移行が強調されています。
Interventional Cardiology.summary_en: The article discusses the implementation of an accelerated diagnostic pathway (ADP) for myocardial infarction diagnosis using high-sensitivity cardiac troponin (hs-cTn) assays. It highlights the shift from traditional testing methods to more timely strategies that can improve patient outcomes by allowing for quicker confirmation or exclusion of myocardial infarction.
Interventional Cardiology.outcomes: It highlights the shift from traditional testing methods to more timely strategies that can improve patient outcomes by allowing for quicker confirmation or exclusion of myocardial infarction.
Interventional Cardiology.key_takeaway: 心筋梗塞診断のための加速診断経路の導入が推奨されています。

THV.title: PARADIGM trial of DurAVR TAVI valve to begin enrolling at French centres
THV.summary_jp: Anteris Technologiesは、フランスの医薬品および健康製品安全庁からDurAVR経カテーテル心臓弁のグローバル試験であるPARADIGM試験の規制承認を受けました。この試験は、重度の石灰化大動脈狭窄症の患者におけるDurAVR弁の安全性と有効性を評価し、フランスの主要なセンターで約1,000人の患者を募集します。
THV.summary_en: Anteris Technologies has received regulatory clearance from the French National Agency for Medicines and Health Products Safety for the DurAVR transcatheter heart valve global pivotal trial, known as the PARADIGM trial. This trial will evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the DurAVR valve in patients with severe calcific aortic stenosis and will enroll approximately 1,000 patients across leading centers in France.
THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 1000 (patients)
Follow-up: 1 year (post procedure)
Primary endpoint: all-cause mortality, all stroke, cardiovascular hospitalization
THV.key_takeaway: DurAVR弁のPARADIGM試験がフランスでの患者募集を開始。

TAVR / THV.title: Great debate: surgical aortic valve replacement is first choice for aortic stenosis in patients with a life expectancy beyond 5 years.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、5年以上の余命がある患者に対する大動脈狭窄症の治療法として、外科的な大動脈弁置換術（SAVR）と経カテーテル大動脈弁植込み術（TAVI）の比較についての議論が紹介されています。最近のガイドラインでは70歳以上の患者にTAVIが推奨されていますが、TAVIに関連する長期的な結果や合併症に関する懸念が、特定の患者に対してSAVRを第一選択肢として支持する可能性があります。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: The article discusses the ongoing debate regarding the preferred treatment for aortic stenosis in patients with a life expectancy exceeding five years, comparing surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) and transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). While recent guidelines favor TAVI for patients aged 70 and older, concerns about long-term outcomes and complications associated with TAVI may still support SAVR as the first choice for certain patients.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 5年以上の余命がある患者に対してSAVRが第一選択肢であるべきかの議論が続いています。
TAVR / THV.authors: Doenst T, Prendergast B, Allen CJ, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Escalating Diameter Buddy Balloon in Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation With Complex Aortic Arch.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、複雑な大動脈弓を持つ80歳女性の経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）の症例について説明しています。著者たちは、手技中に直面した困難を克服するために、直径を増加させるバディバルーン技術を使用した成功例を紹介しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This article discusses a case of transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) in an 80-year-old female with a complex aortic arch. The authors describe the use of an escalating diameter buddy balloon technique to successfully navigate difficulties encountered during the procedure.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 直径を増加させるバディバルーン技術は、THVシステムの進行における課題に対する安全で効果的な出口戦略を提供します。
TAVR / THV.authors: Paolucci L, Scarpelli M, Maselli D, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Left and right heart remodeling at 1 year after transcatheter versus surgical aortic valve replacement: A speckle-tracking echocardiography study.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、スぺックルトラッキング心エコーを用いて経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVR）と外科的弁置換術（SAVR）後の左心および右心のリモデリングを比較しています。左心機能は安定している一方で、右心機能はSAVR後により顕著に悪化し、エコー指標が予後予測において重要であることを示しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study compares left and right heart remodeling after transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) and surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) using speckle-tracking echocardiography. It finds that while left ventricular function remains stable, right ventricular function deteriorates more significantly after SAVR, highlighting the prognostic value of echocardiographic parameters in predicting outcomes.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 373 (TAVR n=195; SAVR n=178)
Postop RV function deterioration: p < 0.001
Preop LAVI predicts mortality: adjusted OR 1.03, 95% CI 1.02-1.05; p = 0.001
Preop LAVI predicts AF recurrence: OR 1.04, 95% CI 1.02-1.06; p = 0.001
Stroke predicted by preop RV-GLS: OR 0.91; p = 0.031
Stroke predicted by TAPSE: OR 1.12; p = 0.013
Postop LAVI predicts mortality: OR 1.06; p = 0.001
Postop RV-FWS predicts mortality: OR 1.06; p = 0.016
Postop RV-GLS predicts mortality: OR 1.10; p = 0.006
Postop TAPSE predicts mortality: OR 0.93; p = 0.035
Postop LV-GLS associated with mortality: OR 1.08; p = 0.013
Postop LV-GLS associated with AF recurrence: OR 1.16; p = 0.001
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVR後の右心機能のリモデリングはSAVRよりも良好である。
TAVR / THV.authors: Kislitsina ON, Chris Malaisrie S, Thomas JD, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Minimally Invasive TAVR Explantation and Aortic Valve Replacement in a Patient With a Retrosternal Conduit.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、構造的弁変性のためにTAVRの摘出と大動脈弁置換を受けた78歳女性の症例について説明しています。右ミニ胸腔切開を通じて手術が行われ、術後の心エコー検査で弁の正常機能が確認されました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This article discusses a case of a 78-year-old woman who underwent minimally invasive TAVR explantation and aortic valve replacement due to structural valve degeneration. The procedure was performed via right minithoracotomy to avoid injury to a retrosternal conduit, and postoperative echocardiography confirmed normal valve function.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 1 (case report)
Follow-up: Not specified
Mortality: Not specified
Stroke: Not specified
Endpoints: Normal function of the implanted aortic valve confirmed by echocardiography
p-values: Not specified
HR: Not specified
CI: Not specified
Gradients: Not specified
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 右ミニ胸腔切開によるTAVR摘出と大動脈弁置換は安全に行える。
TAVR / THV.authors: Inoue S, Hayatsu Y, Nomura H, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: A novel survival prediction model after isolated surgical aortic valve replacement in the transcatheter aortic valve replacement era.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換時代における大動脈弁置換の外科的結果を調査し、新しい患者特異的生存予測モデルを提案しています。このモデルは、772人の患者の1年および5年の生存率を予測するのに良好な精度を示しました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study examines surgical outcomes of aortic valve replacement in the era of transcatheter aortic valve replacement and proposes a novel patient-specific survival prediction model. The model demonstrated good accuracy in predicting 1- and 5-year survival rates in a cohort of 772 patients.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 772 (total)
Mean age: 74.2 years
Female percentage: 46.9%
1-year survival rate: 96.6%
5-year survival rate: 88.7%
5-year C-statistic (derivation cohort): 0.785 (95% CI: 0.716-0.853)
1-year C-statistic (validation cohort): 0.885 (0.806-0.965)
3-year C-statistic (validation cohort): 0.888 (0.824-0.953)
5-year C-statistic (validation cohort): 0.801 (0.702-0.901)
Intraclass correlation coefficient: 0.955 (95% CI: 0.827-0.989)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 新しい生存予測モデルは、外科的な大動脈弁置換の意思決定を支援する可能性があります。
TAVR / THV.authors: Maeda K, Shimamura K, Pak K, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Valve-in-Valve TAVR Versus Redo Surgery in Women With Degenerated Aortic Bioprosthesis: A Single-Center Experience.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、劣化した生体弁を持つ女性におけるValve-in-Valve TAVRと再手術的弁置換の結果を比較しています。結果は、両手技が短期的に類似の結果をもたらすことを示しており、どちらの選択肢もこの患者群の治療に有効であることを示唆しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study compares the outcomes of Valve-in-Valve TAVR and redo surgical aortic valve replacement in women with degenerated bioprosthetic valves. The results indicate that both procedures yield similar short-term outcomes, suggesting that either option is valid for treating this patient population.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: ViVと再手術的弁置換は短期的に類似の結果を示す。
TAVR / THV.authors: Tagliafierro M, Kanade R, Kirilina D, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Percutaneous Stentectomy: Extraordinary Problems Require Extraordinary Solutions.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: 大腿動脈アクセスを使用して、グース ネック スネアを前進させ、ステントの張り出した部分を捕捉しました。ステントは首尾よく回収され、続いて血管内超音波ガイド下で右冠状動脈入口部に再留置された。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: Using femoral arterial access, a Goose Neck snare was advanced and captured the overhanging part of the stent. The stent was successfully retrieved, followed by restenting of the ostial right coronary artery with intravascular ultrasound guidance.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: The stent was successfully retrieved, followed by restenting of the ostial right coronary artery with intravascular ultrasound guidance.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: Using femoral arterial access, a Goose Neck snare was advanced and captured the overhanging part of the stent. The stent was successfully retrieved, followed by restenting of the ostial right coronary artery with intravascular ultrasound guidance.
TAVR / THV.authors: Nakhle A, Zakhour S, Abdou A, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Simultaneous Valve-in-Valve TAVR With Bioprosthetic Valve Fracture and Left Atrial Appendage Closure for Refractory Left Atrial Thrombus.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この症例報告では、重度の大動脈狭窄と持続的な血栓のために、74歳の男性がバルブインバルブTAVRと左心房付属器閉鎖を同時に受けたことについて述べています。手術は成功し、神経学的合併症はなく、このアプローチが同様の状態の高リスク患者に利益をもたらす可能性があることを示唆しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This case report discusses a 74-year-old man who underwent simultaneous valve-in-valve TAVR and left atrial appendage closure due to severe aortic stenosis and persistent thrombus. The procedure was successful with no neurological complications, suggesting that this approach may benefit high-risk patients with similar conditions.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Patient age: 74 years
Follow-up: Not specified
Neurologic complications: 0
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 高リスク患者における同時バルブ介入と血栓除去が有効である可能性。
TAVR / THV.authors: Chang JH, Liu CH, Chin CS, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Emergent TAV-in-TAV for Failed Bioprosthetic Valve With Severe Aortic Regurgitation Presenting as a Myocardial Infarction.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事は、82歳の男性が失敗した生体弁による重度の大動脈逆流のために緊急の経カテーテル大動脈弁留置術を受けたケースについて述べています。この手技は彼の大動脈逆流を解消し、血行動態の不安定性を改善しました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This article discusses the case of an 82-year-old man who underwent an emergent transcatheter aortic valve-in-valve procedure due to severe aortic regurgitation caused by a failing bioprosthetic valve. The procedure successfully resolved his aortic regurgitation and addressed his hemodynamic instability.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: No numeric data available.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 重度の大動脈不全に対する緊急の経カテーテル大動脈弁留置術の使用が強調されています。
TAVR / THV.authors: Wells J, Iyer V, Fernandez S, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Risk and Outcomes of Reintervention After Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、メディケア患者における経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）後の再介入のリスクと結果を評価しました。再介入のハザードは特に7年後に大幅に増加し、弁狭窄が最も一般的な原因であることがわかりました。死亡率は各期間で類似していましたが、早期の再介入後の心不全入院リスクは高くなりました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study evaluated the risk and outcomes of reintervention after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) in Medicare patients. It found that the hazard of reinterventions increased significantly over time, particularly after 7 years, with valve stenosis being the most common cause. Mortality rates were similar across intervals, but the risk of heart failure hospitalization was higher after early reinterventions.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 2387 (out of 324701)
Early interval hazard rate: 0.26%
Mid-term interval hazard rate: 0.35%
Late interval hazard rate: 0.98%
Valve stenosis reintervention early: 31.3%, mid-term: 60.4%, late: 70.8%, P<0.001
Valve-in-valve procedures early: 53.9%, mid-term: 79.6%, late: 97.2%
30-day mortality risk: similar across intervals
1-year mortality risk: similar across intervals
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVI後の再介入リスクは時間とともに増加する。
TAVR / THV.authors: Alabbadi S, Toyoda N, Itagaki S, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Commentary: Aortic Valve Reinterventions post TAVI: Alarming Trends in Younger, Lower-risk Medicare Patients with High One-Year Mortality.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この解説では、若年で低リスクのメディケア患者におけるTAVI後の大動脈弁再介入に関する傾向について論じており、この層における1年死亡率が予想外に高いことを強調しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This commentary discusses concerning trends regarding aortic valve reinterventions following TAVI in younger, lower-risk Medicare patients, highlighting the unexpectedly high one-year mortality rates in this demographic.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: This commentary discusses concerning trends regarding aortic valve reinterventions following TAVI in younger, lower-risk Medicare patients, highlighting the unexpectedly high one-year mortality rates in this demographic.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: This commentary discusses concerning trends regarding aortic valve reinterventions following TAVI in younger, lower-risk Medicare patients, highlighting the unexpectedly high one-year mortality rates in this demographic.
TAVR / THV.authors: Pereira SJ

TAVR / THV.title: Stroke after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: the limits of progress.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、経カテーテル大動脈弁移植 (TAVR) 後の脳卒中の発生に関連する課題と制限について説明します。これらのリスクを理解し、軽減するにはさらなる研究の必要性が浮き彫りになっています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: The article discusses the challenges and limitations associated with stroke occurrences following transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVR). It highlights the need for further research to understand and mitigate these risks.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: The article discusses the challenges and limitations associated with stroke occurrences following transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVR).
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: The article discusses the challenges and limitations associated with stroke occurrences following transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVR).
TAVR / THV.authors: Okuno T, Gatuz MV

TAVR / THV.title: Safety and Device Success of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement: A 12-Year Single-Center VARC-3 Report.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、コロンビアの単一センターにおける経カテーテル大動脈弁置換（TAVR）の12年間の経験を報告しており、技術的およびデバイスの成功率を強調しています。研究では、30日間の死亡率が7.4%であり、糖尿病が死亡率のリスク因子であることが示されました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study reports on a 12-year experience with transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) at a single center in Colombia, highlighting its technical and device success rates. The study found a 30-day mortality rate of 7.4% and identified diabetes mellitus as a risk factor for increased mortality.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 134
Median age: 80 years
Technical success: 95.5%
Device success at 30 days: 81.3%
30-day mortality: 7.4%
Acute kidney injury: 19.4%
Permanent pacemaker implantation: 18.7%
Vascular complications: 12.7%
AOR for diabetes mellitus and 30-day mortality: 1.25 (95% CI 1.07-2.41; p = 0.021)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVRはコロンビアにおいて高い技術的成功率を示しました。
TAVR / THV.authors: Rojas-Perdomo JD, Uribe-Díaz S, Hurtado-Ordóñez EF, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Perioperative continuous vs. interrupted oral anticoagulation in TAVR: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この系統的レビューとメタアナリシスでは、TAVRの周術期における継続的抗凝固療法と中断抗凝固療法の結果を評価しました。継続的抗凝固療法は重大な出血や血管合併症のリスクを有意に増加させないことが示唆されており、脳卒中のリスクが低下する可能性があるものの、証拠は限られています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the outcomes of continuous versus interrupted oral anticoagulation during the perioperative period of TAVR. The findings suggest that continuous anticoagulation does not significantly increase the risk of major bleeding or vascular complications, and may be associated with a lower risk of stroke, although the evidence is limited.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 3316 (total patients)
Major bleeding: not significantly increased (comparison)
Major vascular complications: not significantly increased (comparison)
Stroke: borderline association with lower risk (comparison)
Red blood cell transfusion: lower (comparison)
Device success rates: higher (comparison)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVRにおける継続的抗凝固療法は安全性が高い可能性があります。
TAVR / THV.authors: Gan X, Lang Z, Meng X, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Perioperative thrombocytopenia after transcatheter versus surgical bioprosthetic aortic valve replacement: a single-center retrospective study.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、重度の大動脈狭窄症患者における経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）と外科的弁置換術（SAVR）間の周術期血小板減少症を比較しています。両手技術とも血小板減少を引き起こしますが、SAVRはTAVIに比べてより顕著で持続的な血小板数の減少と関連しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study compares perioperative thrombocytopenia between transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) in patients with severe aortic stenosis. It finds that while both procedures lead to thrombocytopenia, SAVR is associated with a more significant and sustained decrease in platelet counts compared to TAVI, which shows a more gradual reduction.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 248 (SAVR: 132; TAVI: 116)
Platelet count decline: significant intraoperatively and on POD1 and POD2
POD1 to POD2 decline: statistically significant
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: SAVRはTAVIに比べて血小板数の急激な減少を引き起こす。
TAVR / THV.authors: Karaca Ö, Tüysüz ME, Elbir F, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Prognostic impact of iliofemoral access-site calcification volume on outcomes after transcatheter aortic valve implantation.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）後の結果に対する腸腰動脈アクセス部位の石灰化体積の予後的影響を評価しています。短期的な結果には影響しないものの、高い腸腰動脈石灰化体積は、手術後3年および5年での長期的な死亡率の増加と関連しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study evaluates the prognostic impact of iliofemoral access-site calcification volume on outcomes after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). It finds that while short-term outcomes are unaffected, high iliofemoral calcification volume is associated with increased long-term mortality rates at 3 and 5 years post-procedure.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 1067
Median IASC-volume: 907 (356-1839) mm3
1-year mortality: 11.7% (10.5% vs. 12.8%; p=0.20)
3-year mortality: 34.3% (vs. 22.3%; p<0.01)
5-year mortality: 42.2% (vs. 28.7%; p<0.01)
HR: 1.24 (95% CI 1.11-1.38; p<0.01)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: 腸腰動脈石灰化体積はTAVI後の長期死亡率に関連しています。
TAVR / THV.authors: Vij V, Schauwienold K, Shamekhi J, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: From Theory to Practice: GPT-Supported Data Extraction in Observational Studies on Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換（TAVR）の観察研究における電子健康記録からのデータ抽出にGPTベースのモデルを使用することを評価しています。このモデルは、高い精度と感度を示し、特に連続測定や稀な術中合併症において、臨床研究におけるデータ収集の効率化の可能性を示唆しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study evaluates the use of a GPT-based model for data extraction from electronic health records in observational studies of transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR). The model demonstrated high accuracy and sensitivity, particularly for continuous measurements and rare intraoperative complications, suggesting its potential to streamline data collection in clinical research.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 108 cases
Accuracy (valve brand): 0.657
Accuracy (gender, Barthel index, procedure timings, intraoperative complications): 1.00
Sensitivity (intraoperative neurological complications): 1.00
Specificity: >0.90 for most variables
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: GPTベースのデータ抽出は高い精度を示し、臨床研究のデータ収集を効率化できる可能性があります。
TAVR / THV.authors: Brigiari G, Dotto R, Cernetti C, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Prevalence and prognostic implications of the Valve Academic Research Consortium-High Bleeding Risk criteria in patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁植込み術（TAVI）を受ける患者における高出血リスク（HBR）基準の有病率とその予後的意義を評価しています。8464人の患者のうち、60％が高または非常に高い出血リスクと特定され、出血リスクと有害心血管イベントの間に有意な関連が見られました。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study evaluates the prevalence of high bleeding risk (HBR) criteria in patients undergoing transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and its prognostic implications. Among 8464 patients, 60% were identified as high or very high bleeding risk, with significant associations found between bleeding risk and adverse cardiovascular events.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Total patients: 8464
Very high risk: 1966 (23.2%)
High risk: 3311 (39.1%)
Moderate risk: 2075 (24.5%)
Low risk: 1112 (13.1%)
In-hospital bleeding (low risk): 11.0%
In-hospital bleeding (moderate risk): 17.2%
In-hospital bleeding (high risk): 20.0%
In-hospital bleeding (very high risk): 22.2%
p-value: <0.001
2-year major adverse cardiovascular events (low risk): 13.8%
2-year major adverse cardiovascular events (moderate risk): 13.1%
2-year major adverse cardiovascular events (high risk): 18.6%
2-year major adverse cardiovascular events (very high risk): 25.4%
p-value: <0.001
Mortality after bleeding event (HR): 1.71 (95% CI 1.50 to 1.95)
Mortality within first 3 months (HR): 2.88 (95% CI 2.33 to 3.56)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVI患者の60％が高または非常に高い出血リスクに該当。

TAVR / THV.title: Successful Balloon Valvuloplasty for Paravalvular Leak 4 Months After TAVR in a Bicuspid Aortic Valve.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、バイカスピッド大動脈弁のTAVRを受けた患者において、4か月後に発生したパラバルブ漏れ（PVL）に対して成功したバルーンバルブプラスティの症例を紹介しています。手技は、患者の解剖学とPVLの原因を評価する多職種チームによって導かれ、治療選択肢を決定する際の画像診断の重要性が強調されています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This article discusses a case of successful balloon valvuloplasty performed on a patient with a paravalvular leak (PVL) four months after undergoing TAVR for a bicuspid aortic valve. The procedure was guided by a multidisciplinary team's evaluation of the patient's anatomy and the etiology of the PVL, highlighting the importance of imaging in determining treatment options.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: A 70-year-old man underwent TAVR for bicuspid aortic stenosis using a balloon-expandable valve. A partially fused commissural raphe causing focal underexpansion was identified as the origin of PVL, and late balloon valvuloplasty was performed successfully.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: バイカスピッド弁におけるTAVR後のバルーンバルブプラスティは安全な選択肢です。
TAVR / THV.authors: Mosaad M, Algazlan S, Alshamardl K, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Modified Guide Anchoring "UNICORN" Technique for Valve-in-Valve TAVI: Navigating Hostile Anatomy With Leaflet Laceration.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この記事では、失敗したパーセヴァルバルブと困難な冠動脈解剖を持つ患者に対するバルブインバルブ経カテーテル大動脈弁植込みのための修正ガイドアンカリング技術「UNICORN」について説明しています。この技術は、リーフレットの切開とバルーン拡張弁の成功した植込みを可能にし、縫合なし生体弁がもたらす独自の課題に対処します。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This article discusses a modified guide anchoring technique called UNICORN for valve-in-valve transcatheter aortic valve implantation in a patient with a failing Perceval valve and challenging coronary anatomy. The technique allows for leaflet laceration and successful implantation of a balloon-expandable valve, addressing the unique challenges posed by sutureless bioprostheses.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: A balloon-expandable valve was then successfully implanted.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: ガイドアンカリングは、複雑なシナリオにおいて心室アクセスを確保し、機械的切開を可能にする短い青写真を提供します。
TAVR / THV.authors: Althobaiti M, Alghadeer S, Alsaileek A, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Feasibility of Robotic Hybrid CABG and Transcarotid TAVI for Severe Aortic Stenosis and Coronary Disease.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この症例報告は、重度の大動脈狭窄症と多血管冠動脈疾患を持つ高リスク患者において、ロボットハイブリッド冠動脈バイパス移植（RHCABG）と経頸動脈経カテーテル大動脈弁置換（TAVI）の成功した組み合わせについて述べています。段階的ハイブリッドアプローチは、合併症のない回復と重要な機能的改善をもたらし、従来の手術に不適合な患者に対する代替手段としての実現可能性を強調しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This case report discusses the successful combination of robotic hybrid coronary aortic bypass grafting (RHCABG) and transcarotid transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) in a high-risk patient with severe aortic stenosis and multivessel coronary disease. The staged hybrid approach resulted in an uncomplicated recovery and significant functional improvement, highlighting its feasibility as an alternative for patients unsuitable for conventional surgery.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: The patient underwent robotic hybrid coronary aortic bypass grafting (RHCABG), followed 48 hours later by transcarotid transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI). Both procedures succeeded, yielding an uncomplicated recovery and marked functional improvement.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: RHCABGと経頸動脈TAVIの組み合わせは高リスク患者に対して実現可能である。
TAVR / THV.authors: Aluthman U, Bafageeh SW, Barnawi HI, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Impact of Balloon Post-Dilatation Strategy During Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation on the Cardiac Conduction System.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVI）中のバルーン後拡張が心臓の伝導系に与える影響を調査しています。後拡張は新たな左脚ブロック（LBBB）の独立したリスク因子であることがわかり、既存の伝導異常を持つ患者の注意深いモニタリングの必要性が強調されています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of balloon post-dilatation during transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) on the cardiac conduction system. It finds that post-dilatation is an independent risk factor for new-onset left bundle branch block (LBBB), highlighting the need for close monitoring of patients with pre-existing conduction abnormalities.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample size: 282 (patients included)
Mean age: 76.5 ± 6.9 (years)
Female percentage: 63.8%
OR for larger prosthesis diameter: 1.173 (95% CI 1.082-1.271; P < .001)
OR for post-dilatation: 2.147 (95% CI 1.235-3.733; P = .007)
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVI中のバルーン後拡張は新たなLBBBのリスク因子である。
TAVR / THV.authors: Şahan E, Kalaycı S, Şahan S, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Transcatheter Versus Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement in Patients Aged 50 to 65 Years: A Propensity Score-Matched Five-Year Study.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: この研究は、50歳から65歳の患者における経カテーテル大動脈弁置換術（TAVR）と外科的弁置換術（SAVR）の長期的な結果を比較しています。結果は、TAVRが早期の安全性の利点を示す一方で、5年後にはSAVRに比べて死亡率や有害事象のリスクが高いことを示しています。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This study compares long-term outcomes of transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) and surgical aortic valve replacement (SAVR) in patients aged 50 to 65 years. The results indicate that while TAVR shows early safety advantages, it is associated with higher long-term risks of mortality and adverse outcomes compared to SAVR at the five-year mark.
TAVR / THV.outcomes:
Sample Size: 1041 (matched pairs)
30-day Primary Composite Endpoint: 3.0% vs. 5.6% (HR 0.53; 95% CI 0.34-0.82; p=0.004)
30-day All-Cause Mortality: HR 0.50; p=0.03
30-day Major Bleeding: HR 0.29; p<0.001
30-day AKI: HR 0.39; p<0.001
30-day Cardiogenic Shock: HR 0.28; p<0.001
1-year Major Bleeding: HR 0.50; p<0.001
5-year Primary Composite Endpoint: 18.6% vs. 15.5% (HR 1.27; 95% CI 1.03-1.57; p=0.02)
5-year All-Cause Mortality: 13.7% vs. 8.3% (HR 1.81; 95% CI 1.39-2.37; p<0.001)
5-year Major Bleeding: HR 0.65; p<0.001
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: TAVRは早期の安全性を示すが、5年後には死亡率が高くなるリスクがある。
TAVR / THV.authors: Doma M, Ismayl M, Ramadan A, et al.

TAVR / THV.title: Graft-Assisted Transapical Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement with Concomitant Robotic Minimally Invasive Direct Coronary Artery Bypass.
TAVR / THV.summary_jp: これは、多枝冠状動脈疾患と重度の大動脈狭窄を患う 55 歳男性の症例です。患者は最近心不全で複数回入院したが、約1年前に心臓移植を断られていた。
TAVR / THV.summary_en: This is a case of a 55-year-old male with multivessel coronary artery disease and severe aortic stenosis. The patient presented with multiple recent hospitalizations for heart failure and had been turned down for heart transplantation approximately one year prior.
TAVR / THV.outcomes: Ultimately, the patient underwent robotic minimally invasive direct coronary artery bypass with concomitant graft-assisted transapical transcatheter aortic valve replacement.
TAVR / THV.key_takeaway: This is a case of a 55-year-old male with multivessel coronary artery disease and severe aortic stenosis.
TAVR / THV.authors: Bach ERS, Edwards AM, Stankewicz M, et al.

Clinical Trial.title: Right ventricular function-pulmonary pressure interaction as a predictor of mortality in tricuspid regurgitation.
Clinical Trial.summary_jp: この研究は、三尖弁逆流（TR）患者における右心室-肺動脈カップリングと死亡率の関係を調査しています。TAPSE/PASPの低下は、特に中等度から重度のTR患者において高い死亡率と有意に関連していることがわかりました。合成指標は予後の識別に若干の改善を提供する可能性がありますが、さらなる検証が必要です。
Clinical Trial.summary_en: This study investigates the relationship between right ventricular-pulmonary arterial coupling and mortality in patients with tricuspid regurgitation (TR). It finds that reduced TAPSE/PASP is significantly associated with higher mortality rates, particularly in patients with moderate-to-severe TR. The study suggests that while a composite index may offer some improvement in prognostic discrimination, it requires further validation.
Clinical Trial.outcomes:
Sample size: 247 (patients with TR)
Median age: 80 years
Female: 61%
1-year mortality (reduced TAPSE/PASP): 41.9%
1-year mortality (preserved TAPSE/PASP): 16.3%
p < 0.001
HR (TAPSE/PASP): 2.15 (95% CI 1.35-3.43, p = 0.001)
HR (moderate-to-severe TR subgroup): 2.74 (95% CI 1.42-5.28, p = 0.003)
AUC (composite index vs. TAPSE/PASP): 0.691 vs. 0.669
Clinical Trial.key_takeaway: TAPSE/PASPの低下は三尖弁逆流患者の死亡率と独立して関連している。
Clinical Trial.authors: Peri Y, Topilsky Y, Alnees M, et al.

Clinical Trial.title: Validation of the European Society of Cardiology 0/1-hour algorithm for chest pain triage in Asian emergency departments: a multinational stepped-wedge cluster-randomised trial
Clinical Trial.summary_jp: この多国籍の段階的クラスター無作為化試験では、アジアの救急部門における胸痛トリアージのためのESC 0/1時間アルゴリズムを評価し、3869人の患者を登録しました。結果は、このアルゴリズムが安全かつ効果的であり、通常のケアと比較して心血管の重大有害事象において劣らず、退院率が有意に高いことを示しました。
Clinical Trial.summary_en: This multinational stepped-wedge cluster-randomised trial evaluated the ESC 0/1-hour algorithm for chest pain triage in Asian emergency departments, enrolling 3869 patients. The results showed that the algorithm is safe and effective, with a non-inferiority in major adverse cardiac events compared to usual care and significantly higher discharge rates.
Clinical Trial.outcomes:
Sample size: 3869 (total)
MACE in usual care: 1.7%
MACE in 0/1-hour care: 1.4%
ED discharge rate (0/1-hour): 60%
ED discharge rate (usual care): 35%
p-value for discharge rates: <0.001
MACE in low risk group: 3 patients (1 cardiovascular death, 2 unplanned revascularisations)
Clinical Trial.key_takeaway: ESC 0/1時間アルゴリズムはアジアの救急部門で安全かつ効果的です。

Digital Health / AI.title: CMS creates office dedicated to health technology
Digital Health / AI.summary_jp: CMSはデジタルヘルスツールに焦点を当てるため、健康技術および製品のオフィスを設立しました。この取り組みは、医療サービスにおける健康技術の統合を改善することを目的としています。
Digital Health / AI.summary_en: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has established the Office of Health Technology and Products to enhance its focus on digital health tools. This initiative aims to improve the integration of health technology in healthcare services.
Digital Health / AI.outcomes: This initiative aims to improve the integration of health technology in healthcare services.
Digital Health / AI.key_takeaway: CMSがデジタルヘルスツールに特化したオフィスを設立。

Digital Health / AI.title: FDA Clears First Over-the-Counter Continuous Glucose Monitor for Children
Digital Health / AI.summary_jp: FDAは、子供向けの初のOTC連続血糖モニターであるDexcom社のStelo Glucose Biosensor Systemを承認しました。このデバイスは、インスリンを使用しない2歳以上の人々を対象としています。
Digital Health / AI.summary_en: The FDA has approved the first over-the-counter continuous glucose monitor for children, the Stelo Glucose Biosensor System by Dexcom Inc. This device is intended for individuals aged two years and older who do not require insulin.
Digital Health / AI.outcomes: The FDA has approved the first over-the-counter continuous glucose monitor for children, the Stelo Glucose Biosensor System by Dexcom Inc.
Digital Health / AI.key_takeaway: FDAが子供向けのOTC連続血糖モニターを承認。

Digital Health / AI.title: Improving structural heart disease screening: AI-ECG and novice AI-guided focused cardiac ultrasound.
Digital Health / AI.summary_jp: この研究は、995人の成人における構造的心疾患（SHD）の検出に対するAI強化ECGとAIガイド付き集中心臓超音波（AI-FoCUS）の効果を評価しています。AI-ECGとAI-FoCUSを組み合わせた二段階戦略は、高い予測値を示しましたが、必要な画像検査の回数を減少させました。低い有病率の集団でのさらなる検証が必要です。
Digital Health / AI.summary_en: This study evaluates the effectiveness of AI-enhanced ECG and AI-guided focused cardiac ultrasound (AI-FoCUS) for detecting structural heart disease (SHD) in 995 adults. The two-step strategy combining AI-ECG and AI-FoCUS demonstrated high predictive values, although it reduced the number of required imaging sessions. Further validation in populations with lower prevalence is needed.
Digital Health / AI.outcomes:
Sample size: 995
Feasibility of AI-FoCUS: 97.3%
Prevalence of EF < 40%: 5.0%
Prevalence of ≥moderate aortic stenosis: 3.5%
Prevalence of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy or amyloidosis: 8.8%
NPV of AI-ECG: 95.8%
PPV of AI-ECG: 29.6%
PPV of AI-FoCUS: 95.4%
NPV of AI-FoCUS: 98.0%
PPV/NPV of two-step strategy: 96.1%/95.6%
FoCUS imaging limited to: 47%
Digital Health / AI.key_takeaway: AI-FoCUSは構造的心疾患の検出において高い精度を示しました。
Digital Health / AI.authors: Killalea MM, Borgeson J, Kane CJ, et al.

Digital Health / AI.title: Dexcom bolsters evidence for glucose sensors for Type 2 diabetes
Digital Health / AI.summary_jp: 新しい研究が、インスリンを使用しない2型糖尿病患者向けのグルコースセンサーの保険適用の改善の可能性を示しています。この証拠は、これらのデバイスの償還に関する政策変更に影響を与えるかもしれません。
Digital Health / AI.summary_en: A new study highlights the potential for improved insurance coverage for glucose sensors used in Type 2 diabetes management, particularly for patients who do not require insulin. This evidence may influence policy changes regarding the reimbursement of these devices.
Digital Health / AI.outcomes: A new study highlights the potential for improved insurance coverage for glucose sensors used in Type 2 diabetes management, particularly for patients who do not require insulin.
Digital Health / AI.key_takeaway: 2型糖尿病患者向けのグルコースセンサーの保険適用改善の可能性。

Digital Health / AI.title: MiniMed is in the lead as diabetes tech firms focus on ‘fully closed loop’ systems, exec says
Digital Health / AI.summary_jp: MiniMedの最高製品技術責任者アリ・ディアナティによると、同社は完全自動インスリン供給システムの開発において競争相手を「明らかにリードしている」とのことです。食事の通知を必要としない自動化システムに注力しており、競合他社との差別化を図っています。
Digital Health / AI.summary_en: MiniMed is leading in the development of fully closed-loop insulin delivery systems, according to their chief product and technology officer, Ali Dianaty. The company is focusing on automated systems that do not require meal announcements, setting them apart from competitors.
Digital Health / AI.outcomes: MiniMed is leading in the development of fully closed-loop insulin delivery systems, according to their chief product and technology officer, Ali Dianaty. The company is focusing on automated systems that do not require meal announcements, setting them apart from competitors.
Digital Health / AI.key_takeaway: MiniMedは完全自動インスリン供給システムの開発でリードしています。

Heart Failure.title: Severity of mobility limitation and adverse outcomes in heart failure
Heart Failure.summary_jp: この研究は、心不全患者における移動制限の重症度と不利な結果との関係を調査しています。重症度が高いほど、再入院や死亡率が増加することが明らかになりました。
Heart Failure.summary_en: This study investigates the relationship between the severity of mobility limitations and adverse outcomes in heart failure patients. It finds a clear association, with higher severity linked to increased rates of rehospitalization and mortality over a two-year period.
Heart Failure.outcomes:
Sample size: 2103
Follow-up: 2820.7 person-years
Primary outcome incidence rates: 24.9 (category I), 47.0 (category II), 59.3 (category III), 84.8 (category IV) (p for trend <0.001)
Adjusted HR for category II: 1.22 (95% CI 1.04 to 1.45)
Adjusted HR for category III: 1.39 (95% CI 1.11 to 1.73)
Adjusted HR for category IV: 1.71 (95% CI 1.34 to 2.20)
Heart Failure.key_takeaway: 移動制限の重症度と心不全の不利な結果には明確な関連性がある。

Regulatory / FDA.title: FDA Approves Labeling Changes for Over-the-Counter (OTC) Weight Loss Drug alli (Orlistat) to Warn of Risk of Kidney Stones and Kidney Injury
Regulatory / FDA.summary_jp: FDAは、OTCの減量薬alli（オルリスタット）のラベル変更を承認し、急性腎障害や腎結石のリスクについて警告を追加しました。消費者は、使用前に医療提供者に相談することが推奨されています。
Regulatory / FDA.summary_en: The FDA has approved labeling changes for the over-the-counter weight loss drug alli (orlistat) to include warnings about the risk of acute kidney injury and kidney stones. Consumers are now advised to consult a healthcare provider before using the medication.
Regulatory / FDA.outcomes: The FDA has approved labeling changes for the over-the-counter weight loss drug alli (orlistat) to include warnings about the risk of acute kidney injury and kidney stones.
Regulatory / FDA.key_takeaway: OTC薬alliのラベルに急性腎障害のリスク警告が追加されました。
